editorial:
Imagine meeting a girl who claims she can read your future just by looking at your palm. That is exactly how Jayesh finds himself in a mess. He is just a regular guy who thinks he is having a great day until this palmistry expert tells him that he is about to enter the worst phase of his entire life. The vibe of the movie is light and breezy, mixing a bit of romantic tension with a lot of unlucky situations. You will find yourself rooting for Jayesh as he tries to figure out if his life is actually cursed or if he is just having a string of bad luck. It is a fun ride that does not take itself too seriously.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the two leads and the way the jokes land. The pacing stays quick, so you never feel bored. While some of the coincidences feel a bit too convenient, the funny moments make up for it. If you are looking for something to relax with on a weekend, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move. It is a perfect pick for a date night or a lazy afternoon.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you discover that the girl was not actually a pro at palmistry. She made up the bad prediction just to get Jayesh's attention and keep him around her. All the bad things that happened to him were just random accidents that he noticed more because he was scared. They eventually admit their feelings for each other, and Jayesh realizes that his life is actually great because he found love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a twist of fate.
